collections.name: The Suede Velvet Edit
collections.description: The Suede Velvet Edit is an exploration of softness, depth, and quiet presence. This collection reimagines our signature Dahlia Mini through a more tactile lens, where texture leads, and colour reveals itself slowly. Each piece is crafted in suede velvet selected for its richness and subtle variation, designed to move with light and feel unmistakably personal. These bags are designed for close moments. For evenings that linger. For days when detail matters more than display. Intentional by design and limited in expression, The Suede Velvet Edit invites you to experience Dahlia differently, softer, warmer, and undeniably refined.
